Modular Mobile Outdoor Kitchen Unit

Modular Prefab Container Kitchen Unit for Camp, Site, Event

A modular mobile outdoor kitchen unit is a compact, factory-built solution for outdoor cooking, pop-up catering, events, resorts, campsites, and temporary food-service projects. The mobile outdoor kitchen combines a protected cooking area, countertop workspace, storage, refrigeration space, lighting, and a lift-up canopy in one modular structure.

The shown configuration includes a BBQ grill, base cabinets, drawers, countertop workspace, and an under-counter refrigerator. It can be customized according to your project requirements, including kitchen equipment, internal layout, exterior finish, electrical configuration, and utility provisions.

Mobile Kitchen Unit Specifications

This modular mobile outdoor kitchen unit features a galvanized steel structure, an electric-hydraulic lift-up canopy, and a configurable electrical connection system. The following specifications describe the standard reference configuration.

Category Item Standard / Specification
Basic Features External Dimensions W 1,010 × L 2,200 × H 2,450 mm
Internal Dimensions W 810 × L 1,920 × H 2,290 mm
Loading Capacity 10 units per 40-ft High Cube Container
Main Frame Top Beam 80 × 80 × 1.8 mm galvanized steel square tube
Top Purlin 60 × 40 × 1.5 mm galvanized steel square tube
Bottom Beam 80 × 80 × 1.8 mm galvanized steel square tube
Bottom Purlin 60 × 40 × 1.5 mm galvanized steel square tube
Folding Roof Frame 60 × 40 × 1.5 mm galvanized steel square tube
Steel Columns 80 × 80 × 1.8 mm galvanized steel square tube
Frame Protective Coating Baked Powder Coating Powder coating process
Wall Panels Exterior Wall 1.2 mm galvanized steel sheet + 4 mm aluminum composite panel
Interior Wall 16 mm OSB board + 4 mm aluminum composite panel
Flooring Floor Panel 18 mm magnesium oxide board / cement board
Lifting System Electric Hydraulic Lifting Rods Electric hydraulic lifting system
External Power Connection Aviation Plug International-standard aviation plug
Electrical System Wiring 6 mm² incoming power cable; 4 mm² air-conditioning outlets; 1.5 mm² lighting circuits. Electrical systems can be customized to meet local standards and certification requirements.

Final specifications may be adjusted according to the approved kitchen layout, selected equipment, destination-country requirements, and final project drawings.

Based on this compact modular structure, the portable outdoor kitchen unit integrates cooking, preparation, storage, and service functions for outdoor operations.

Mobile Outdoor Kitchen Features

- Compact Outdoor Kitchen Workspace: A compact front-facing layout combines cooking, food preparation, storage, and refrigeration space in one modular unit for outdoor food-service operations.

- Lift-up Canopy for Flexible Service: The openable canopy creates a covered cooking or serving zone and supports a more flexible outdoor operating workflow.

- Factory-built Modular Design: The unit is manufactured as an integrated modular kitchen enclosure, helping simplify project coordination, shipment planning, and on-site deployment.

- Configurable Kitchen Equipment: The layout can be configured with BBQ grills, cooktops, sinks, worktops, storage cabinets, refrigeration, and other equipment according to the intended menu and service capacity.

- Project-specific Utility Planning: Electrical, water, drainage, and ventilation provisions can be planned around the destination market, selected equipment, and local project requirements.

The unit shown is a sample configuration for a compact outdoor kitchen service. The final layout, kitchen equipment, utilities, exterior design, and service arrangements can all be customized to meet your operational needs.

Custom Outdoor Kitchen Configurations

Customization Area Available Options
Kitchen Layout Worktop, cooking zone, cabinets, drawers, service opening, and storage arrangement
Cooking Equipment BBQ grill, cooktop, hotplate, oven, fryer, sink, prep table, and other specified appliances
Refrigeration Under-counter refrigerator, upright refrigerator, freezer, or cold-storage options
Utilities Electrical system, voltage, frequency, plug type, water inlet, drainage, and ventilation provisions
Exterior Appearance Color, cladding, signage area, branding, and canopy finish
Interior Configuration Countertop, cabinets, shelving, lighting, wall finish, and equipment placement
Destination Requirements Electrical and material configurations based on country-specific standards

To receive a project-specific proposal, please share your preferred layout, required kitchen equipment, destination country, quantity, and expected delivery date.

Modular Outdoor Kitchen Applications

The modular mobile outdoor kitchen unit can be configured for different temporary, commercial, and outdoor food-service projects.

    - Outdoor Events and Festivals — A compact cooking or food-preparation station for temporary event operations.

    - Pop-up Catering Businesses — A factory-built kitchen unit for mobile catering, promotional events, and seasonal food service.

    - Resorts and Campsites — An outdoor BBQ kitchen or food-preparation area for guests and recreational facilities.

    - Commercial Outdoor Spaces — A customized cooking unit for markets, food courts, rooftop venues, and outdoor dining areas.

    - Construction and Remote Projects — A small kitchen facility that can be coordinated with modular offices, accommodation units, or temporary camps.

    - Temporary Food-service Facilities — A flexible kitchen option where permanent construction is impractical or not required.

The final suitability for commercial food preparation depends on the selected equipment, ventilation, electrical capacity, water and drainage design, hygiene standards, and local regulatory requirements.

Request a Custom Mobile Outdoor Kitchen Quote

Send NEW BRAND your preferred kitchen layout, cooking equipment list, destination country, electrical requirements, quantity, application, and expected delivery date. Our team will prepare a customized modular mobile outdoor kitchen proposal for your project.

Frequently Asked Questions

1
Can the Mobile Outdoor Kitchen Layout and Equipment Be Customized?
Yes. We can customize the internal layout, cooking appliances, worktops, cabinets, refrigeration, lighting, exterior finish, service opening, and utilities according to the project requirements.
2
Can the Outdoor Kitchen Electrical System Meet Local Standards?
The electrical configuration can be adapted to destination-country requirements. However, you should confirm applicable local electrical codes, certification requirements, appliance approvals, and inspection requirements before ordering.
3
Does the Mobile Outdoor Kitchen Unit Require a Foundation?
The outdoor kitchen unit requires a stable, level, and load-bearing placement surface. The required base may vary depending on the local ground conditions, final product weight, equipment load, wind conditions, drainage design, and local regulations.
4
How Is the Mobile Outdoor Kitchen Unit Transported?
The unit is designed for containerized shipment. According to the standard loading plan, up to 10 units can be loaded into one 40-foot high-cube container. Final loading quantity and packing arrangement should be confirmed before shipment.
5
How Is the Outdoor Kitchen Unit Installed On-Site?
Site installation normally includes unloading, positioning the unit on a prepared base, opening and checking the canopy system, connecting electrical power, and completing any project-specific water, drainage, ventilation, or equipment connections. The exact process depends on the approved configuration and site conditions.
6
Is This Modular Outdoor Kitchen Suitable for Commercial Food Service?
The unit can be configured for commercial catering and outdoor food-service projects. Compliance depends on the final cooking equipment, ventilation, power supply, water and drainage system, food hygiene requirements, fire-safety measures, and local regulations.
7
What Is the Minimum Order Quantity and Production Lead Time?
Minimum order quantity and production lead time depend on the final kitchen configuration, selected equipment, order quantity, production schedule, and destination. Contact NEW BRAND with your project requirements for a confirmed quotation and delivery plan.
